name: section-features
title: Features Section
description: Features section in three layouts (grid, rows, split) that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: Cards in one, two or three columns as the width grows; the default.

layouts.title: Rows
layouts.description: One feature per row, text beside its image from md, the image side alternating.
layouts.usage: <FeaturesSection layout="rows" content={{ title, items: [{ title, description, image }] }} />

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: The title and intro in one column beside the features from md, stacked on a phone.

proof: installs alone on Next 16; three layouts (grid, rows, split); default look equals 2.0.0; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no colour, font or radius leak
postMessage: See components/section-features/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
